prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Magnet, of the Iron Nation — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: her living room with a deep sofa, floor cushions and a low table
Weather / season: high summer — strong sunlight and deep shadows.
Time of day: late morning — clear fresh daylight, soft short shadows; morning light slanting through the window across the floor.
Small moment: one stubborn strand of her hair sticks up from sleep.
Outfit: a one-piece swimsuit with long fabric ties wrapped twice around the waist and knotted at the back — in pale chambray blue; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a textured crinkle swim fabric, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: kneeling on the ground.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body in side profile, her face in profile too — only her eyes turn toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her knee — her far arm, on the side away from the camera; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her near arm, on the camera side.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: brows level, eyes bright and steady, closed-lip smile with a firm mouth.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
